name: Kinkaku-ji
_about: Kinkaku-ji's surfaces: the upper two storeys covered in gold leaf over black lacquer, the first plain timber and white plaster; the roofs of cypress-bark shingles (hiwadabuki), dark brown; the bracket sets and the phoenix gilt; the island's edge and the bridge granite, the island raked gravel.

rules._about: the undersides: the rafters and boards
the phoenix on the apex, gilt bronze
the bracket sets under the upper eaves, gilt
the Tower of Sound Waves and the Cupola of the Ultimate, gold leaf over lacquer
the first storey: dark timber, white plaster between
